description_en: Queries the association between an Express Connect Router (ECR) and a route map
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）与路由策略的关联关系
name: ListRouteMapAssociations

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether this is a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request but does not modify EPS resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client and make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to start the next query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query is to be sent, this parameter is not required.
If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the last API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route map in the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
parameters.help_zh: 路由策略ID，即云企业网CEN（Cloud Enterprise Network）中的路由策略
parameters.name: route_map_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route map association
parameters.name: association_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denied error

Code.description_en: The status code that indicates whether the call is successful. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. For more information about the causes of failure, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示成功，返回其他值表示失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage error message.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

Message.description_en: The message returned for the operation

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to start the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query is to be sent.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token used to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空，表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

RouteMapAssociationList.description_en: The list of route map associations
RouteMapAssociationList.description_zh: 路由策略关联关系列表

AssociationId.description_en: The ID of the route map association

Direction.description_en:
The direction in which the routing policy is applied. Valid values:

Inbound: the inbound region gateway direction, indicating the direction in which routing is transmitted to the Express Connect Router (ECR).
Outbound: the outbound region gateway direction, indicating the direction in which routing is transmitted from the Express Connect Router (ECR)
Direction.description_zh:
路由策略的应用方向。取值：

Inbound：入地域网关方向，表示路由传入专线网关的方向。
Outbound：出地域网关方向，表示路由传出专线网关的方向

EcrId.description_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)

GmtCreate.description_en:
The time when the route map association was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
GmtCreate.description_zh:
路由策略关联关系的创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

GmtModified.description_en:
The time when the route map association was updated.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
GmtModified.description_zh:
路由策略关联关系的修改时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

Priority.description_en: The priority of the route map. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 路由策略的优先级。优先级数字越小，代表优先级越高

RegionIdList.description_en: The list of region IDs where the route map is distributed and takes effect
RegionIdList.description_zh: 路由策略下发并生效的地域ID列表

RouteMapId.description_en: The ID of the route map

Status.description_en:
The status of the route map association. Valid values:

CREATING: The association is being created.
ACTIVE: The association is in a normal state, and no operations are in progress.
DELETING: The association is being deleted.
UPDATING: The association is being updated.
DELETED: The association is deleted
Status.description_zh:
路由策略关联关系的状态。取值：

CREATING：创建中。
ACTIVE：正常状态，没有任何操作正在进行中。
DELETING：删除中。
UPDATING：修改中。
DELETED：已删除

Version.description_en: The version number of the route map. The version number increments when the route map in the CEN is changed
Version.description_zh: 路由策略的版本号。云企业网CEN侧的路由策略发生变更时，该版本号递增

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

True: The call is successful.
False: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of route map associations
TotalCount.description_zh: 路由策略关联关系的总数
